high_level_description: This image is a photograph taken from inside a car, showing the side mirror and part of the car's exterior. The main focus is on a bird that appears to be in mid-flight, seemingly trying to reach for food being offered by a person's hand. The bird is positioned in front of the car, with its wings spread wide as it approaches the food. The text overlay at the top of the image reads "The Rolling Shutter Effect," indicating that the image demonstrates this optical phenomenon.
